Author: Sushil Kukreja
Bench: Sushil Kukreja
Ranjeet Singh Vs. State of Hp
 .
 Cr.MP(M) No.1511 of 2023
20.06.2023
Present: Mr. Sarthak Mehta, Advocate, for the petitioner.
Mr. Jitender Kumar Sharma, Additional Advocate General, for the respondent.

Mr. Jitender Kumar Sharma, learned Additional Advocate General, accepts notice on behalf
of time to file status report.
He prays for and is granted three weeks' Heard.

In the interim, it is ordered that petitioner shall be released on bail, in the event of his arrest, in case FIR No.07/2023, dated 17.06.2023, registered at Police Station SV&ACB, Hamirpur, District Hamirpur, H.P., under Sections 409, 420 & 120B, IPC and Sections 12, 13(1)(a) & 13(2) of the Prevention of Corruption Act,
on his furnishing personal bond to the tune of Rs.50,000/-, with one surety in the like amount, to the satisfaction of the Investigating Officer, subject to the following conditions:-
1. That the petitioner will join investigation of case as and when called for by the Investigating Officer, in accordance with law;
2.
This order shall remain in force till .
